summary: Apple Hospitality REIT filed an 8-K disclosing a fourth amended and restated credit agreement, refinancing its existing senior unsecured credit facilities. The agreement increases the revolving credit facility from $650 million to $700 million, extends maturities: revolver to July 2030, Term A-1 loan to July 2031, Term A-2 loan to January 2032. The borrower is the company with Bank of America as administrative agent. The filing details an ordinary refinancing and extension of existing debt, including an accordion feature to increase total commitments up to $1.75 billion. This is a routine debt amendment, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or extraordinary corporate event is announced.
